## Description {#details}

<p>This class evaluates the compare condition by matching it against the condition of loop latch.</p>


<p>If there is a match we assume a true value for the condition while building <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/scev">SCEV</a> nodes.</p>
